name: field
title: Field
description: A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.
usage: Wrap every form control (Input, Textarea, InputGroup) in a Field with a FieldLabel; add FieldDescription for a hint and FieldError for the message. A Checkbox or Switch goes inside its FieldLabel, next to the text. A group of options (RadioGroup, CheckboxGroup) is one Field: a FieldLegend first inside the group, then a FieldItem per option with its FieldLabel and, if needed, its own FieldDescription. Group related Fields under a heading with FieldSet and FieldLegend. With TanStack Form, render it from form.Field and pass the field: <form.Field name="host">{(field) => <Field field={field}>…</Field>}</form.Field>, and wire the control's value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Without a form library, set invalid and FieldError's children yourself, or use Base UI's validate prop. Put the fields in a Form.

props.name: field
props.type: FieldState (a TanStack Form field: name and state.meta)
props.description: Takes name, touched, dirty and invalid (touched and not valid) from a TanStack Form field, and gives FieldError its errors.

props.name: name
props.description: The control's name; defaults to field.name.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid (data-invalid, aria-invalid on the control) and shows FieldError; overrides the TanStack field.

props.name: touched
props.description: Controlled touched state (data-touched); defaults to the TanStack field's.

props.name: dirty
props.description: Controlled dirty state (data-dirty); defaults to the TanStack field's.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control and dims the label (data-disabled on every part).

props.name: validate
props.description: Base UI's own validation, for a field without a form library.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The column that holds the parts; data-slot="field" and Base UI's data-invalid, data-touched, data-dirty, data-disabled.

slots.name: label
slots.description: FieldLabel, an inline row that can wrap a Checkbox, Radio or Switch; data-slot="field-label".

slots.name: error
slots.description: FieldError, rendered only while the field is invalid; data-slot="field-error".

slots.name: item
slots.description: FieldItem, one option of a group; data-slot="field-item".

slots.name: legend
slots.description: FieldLegend, the name of a FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup; data-slot="field-legend".

parts.name: FieldLabel
parts.description: The visible label, tied to the control; an inline row with gap space.inline.sm, so it can wrap a Checkbox, Radio or Switch and its text; danger-coloured while invalid, dimmed while disabled.

parts.name: FieldDescription
parts.description: A hint under the control, in color.fg.muted, named by aria-describedby.

parts.name: FieldError
parts.description: The validation message in color.status.danger.fg: its children, its errors prop, or the TanStack field's errors one per line.

parts.name: FieldItem
parts.description: One option of a RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup: its FieldLabel and FieldDescription in a column with gap space.stack.xs; disabled disables that option.

parts.name: FieldSet
parts.description: A <fieldset> grouping related Fields under a FieldLegend, a column with gap space.stack.md; disabled disables every control inside.

parts.name: FieldLegend
parts.description: The name of a FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup, placed first inside it, in text.label; the group's aria-labelledby points to it.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Invalid: the label (or a group's FieldLegend; options keep their colour) turns color.status.danger.fg, the control shows its danger border, FieldError appears.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The control is disabled and the label dims to opacity.disabled.

accessibility: FieldLabel is a <label> tied to the control, so clicking it focuses the control and screen readers announce it as the control's name.
FieldDescription and FieldError are named in the control's aria-describedby; the error is read when the control is focused.
A FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup is named by its FieldLegend through aria-labelledby; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only.
An invalid field sets aria-invalid on the control; the message, not the danger colour, carries the meaning.
Show errors after the user leaves the field or submits (the default with a TanStack field: touched and invalid), not on the first keystroke.
color.status.danger.fg and color.fg.muted are contrast-checked as text on every surface.
